items.title: H1 2026 manager review — Meets+
items.text: Reviewer: Arjun Malhotra. Platform hit 99.84% enterprise uptime and shipped retrieval v2. Strong at developing senior ICs and protecting focus time. Growth area: cross-org influence — Platform's needs (headcount for sandbox, ownership of shared problems like agent memory) are raised but not resolved. Goal: get clear ownership for cross-team items that touch Platform KRs.

items.title: Skip-level feedback from Platform team
items.text: Team says Priya is a great advocate and gives honest career feedback. Asks: more visibility into how Platform work maps to company goals; clearer path to Staff for L4s (Jordan Rivera and Luis Romero both mentioned).

items.title: Self-reflection: Q4 KRs are coupled to an unowned problem
items.text: PE-KR1 (indexing latency) and PE-KR2 (retrieval contribution to agent task success) are both capped by the same root cause: nothing persists between agent sessions. That's R-14, unowned since July. PE-KR4 (sandbox) is understaffed and waiting on Q1 headcount. Best move: get Jordan to lead R-14 with Agent Eng partnership — it unblocks my KRs and is Jordan's Staff case.

items.title: Shipped: Platform on-call revamp
items.text: Reduced pages per on-call week from 31 to 9 by tiering alerts and adding runbooks in Hearth. Sev-1 MTTR down from 3.1h to 1.4h.
